training_reason: User authorizes implementation; all training is launched manually by the user.

prototype_defaults.routing: one destination per source within the 3x3 neighborhood; uncertain routes stay
prototype_defaults.implemented: isolated mechanisms plus phase_grid_refiner_v1; see local_4060.json for the distinct trainable-network numeric contract

trainable_refiner.input: 32 polarity/pixel-phase counts + 32 last-event times per 4px cell; labels and teacher predictions excluded
trainable_refiner.sequence_state: carried across windows; gradients detached per 100ms; reset only at sequence boundaries
trainable_refiner.output: 4 LIF prototypes for each of 32 polarity/pixel-phase queries; 128 grid channels
trainable_refiner.router: label-free local activity heuristic, not learned motion
trainable_refiner.training_data: all closed-prefix events build state; only frozen Proposal candidates contribute classification/KD loss
trainable_refiner.evaluation_data: all closed-prefix events, including Proposal rejects; teacher evaluated on identical events

time_contract.burst_counts: count n represents n binary spikes, not one multivalued AC
time_contract.routing_update: simultaneous snapshot; each source consumed at most once

evaluation_policy.new_subgroup_thresholds: derive only from Train-main, then freeze
